blind.description: A stylized wooden poultry nesting box divided into three equal compartments, resting on four short corner legs. The back wall is higher than the front, giving the side walls a forward-sloping top edge. Each compartment contains an orange-brown circular straw nest holding three smooth, cream-colored eggs. The geometry is clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted wooden plank textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame divided into three square bays, each holding a round brown nest ring filled with three pale eggs.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around knee height to the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet long.
